svg.title: grocery-deals-agent: animated agent flow
svg.desc: A 16 second loop: a user enters an address and a recipe, the FastAPI backend geocodes it, six chain agents acquire offers in parallel by tier (JSON feeds, VLM-read leaflets on GPU 1, a self-healing browser; REWE blocked), offers are cached in Postgres, the recipe planner on GPU 0 streams ingredients, per-item basket agents call tools and an optimizer returns single-store and split plans. Every hop is traced to Langfuse; Prometheus and Grafana watch the GPUs; an eval loop scores models.

text.tspan: The user types an address and a recipe into the mission control UI.
The request reaches FastAPI; Nominatim geocodes it and the nearest store of each chain is picked.
Six chain agents run in parallel: JSON feeds, VLM-read leaflets on GPU 1, a self-healing browser; REWE is blocked.
Offers are normalized, embedded with bge-m3 and cached in Postgres until each leaflet ends.
The planner on GPU 0 streams ingredients you can edit; basket agents call tools; the optimizer returns two plans.
Every hop is an OpenTelemetry span in Langfuse; Prometheus scrapes vLLM and DCGM for Grafana.
Eval loop: gold labels run as a Langfuse experiment, scores per model feed the Evals tab; the CI gate stays off until a model passes.
